title: Count Positive, Negative, and Zero Values
statement: Given an integer array nums, return how many numbers are positive, negative, and zero.
think: What is the task asking? Count numbers in three groups.
What is the key operation? Compare each number with zero.
What wording signals stand out? Positive, negative, zero, count.
What is the brute force idea? Separate passes for each category.
What is the better/optimal idea? One pass with three counters.
What are the edge cases? All positives, all zeroes, all negatives.
What is the complexity? O(n) time and O(1) space.
How would I explain it in an interview? I iterate once and classify each number relative to zero.
interview: I would use one pass through the array and classify each value as positive, negative, or zero.
ru: Это простая задача на классификацию чисел. За один проход сравниваем каждое число с нулём.
visualExplanation:
nums = [-1, 0, 5, 7, -3]
-1 -> negative
0 -> zero
5 -> positive
7 -> positive
-3 -> negative

critical: Treat zero as positive or negative
important: Forget one of the three counters

gaps: Nice to have: explain one-pass classification
whyThisPattern: This is a Linear Scan because each number is processed once with a simple branching condition.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not Dictionary, because no mapping is needed.
Not Two Pointers, because no rearrangement is required.
